## Emoji reactions and roleplay text

Two new ways to express yourself, both floating right above your character for everyone nearby to see.

### Emoji Reactions

The **Emojis** category is now stocked with 20 reactions — smile, cry, laugh, angry, and more. Pick one from the menu, or fire it instantly with a chat command (`/smile`, `/cry`, `/laught`, ...). The emoji floats above your head for everyone close by.

![Emoji reaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/14aa01a/.github/release-assets/v1.5.0-emoji.png)

Fully self-contained — no extra resource needed. Size, duration and visibility distance are all tunable in the config.

### RP Text — /me and /do

New `/me` and `/do` commands float a styled pill above your head describing your action, visible to nearby players.

![/me roleplay text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/14aa01a/.github/release-assets/v1.5.0-me.png)

Per-channel command name, range and colour are configurable, and the whole feature has a master on/off toggle. Messages are sanitised and length-capped server-side. If you already run a `/me` system, just rename or disable the channels in the config.

### Improvements

- A performance pass on the menu — faster filtering and search, fewer re-renders
- Card entrance animations and a smooth cascade when you switch category
- The config file was tidied up: same settings, far less clutter, easier to read

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots and custom lists are kept.

Requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest.
